hits.about: 360 Riverside Crescent - the sixth tower in the Riverside Crescent complex by developer Sobha Realty, located in Hartland 2. The building is identical to 310 Riverside Crescent, has 70 floors and offers luxury apartments with 1-2 bedrooms. The facades are designed in a contemporary style, the interiors of each residence utilize high quality natural materials, and the panoramic windows offer stunning views of the lagoon and Downtown Dubai.The tower is surrounded by a green landscaped park with many recreational facilities, walking and jogging paths and a picturesque lagoon. The complex also has a swimming pool, gym, children's playgrounds and sports fields, beach area on the lagoon shore, 24-hour security with CCTV. In the immediate vicinity there are kindergartens, schools, medical facilities, supermarkets, stores, cafes and restaurants.360 Riverside Crescent is located in the closed community of Hartland 2 which has direct access to Ras Al Khor Road, Dubai Al Ain Road and Manama Street. Just 3 minutes away is the famous Ras Al Khor large nature reserve, 5 minutes away is the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and Meydan Racecourse. Dubai Opera can be reached in 10 minutes and Dubai International Airport, Dubai International Financial Center, Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah are about 20 minutes away.The complex is ideal for personal living, family living and also has a huge investment appeal, guaranteeing a stable income. The average ROI for a 1 bedroom residence in Riverside Crescent is > 6.3% with an average rental value of AED 95 000 per year.
